title: JSFL: pasteFrames passes [] as layerIds, pastes into wrong layer
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts around line 1045, pasteFrames passes [] as layer IDs instead of [layerId]. This causes clipboard data to be applied to the topmost layer instead of the active layer. Fix: pass [layerId] (the active/selected layer) instead of [] — same pattern as the copyFrames fix in task 1084.
